newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech BICS100 bond index rises 0.003pts to 102.713.
newsitem.headline: Czech BICS100 bond index rises 0.003pts to 102.713.

text.p: The BICS 100 index measuring the Czech Republic's most liquid bonds rose 0.003 points in Monday's trading to 102.713, bank Ceska Sporitelna said.
It said the duration of the index portfolio shortened by 0.009 points to 2.575 years.

The BICSG 100 index, which Ceska Sporitelna calculates using only government bonds, rose 0.005 points to 99.546, the bank said, and the duration of the index portfolio shortened by 0.009 points to 2.422 years.
It said the yield index YBICS 1000 fell 1.141 points to 1,052.279.
